run_qualification_tool_main: run the qualification_tool.py main block to print an MTurk HIT HTML template for three Minecraft commands
render_qualification_html_template: render the HTML qualification template with BEFORE and AFTER constants for an MTurk HIT page
generate_css_script_for_conditional_word: generate the CSS_SCRIPT string that conditionally hides up to 30 words per command across 3 commands
use_before_constant_for_mturk_instructio: use the BEFORE constant to embed Bootstrap-styled MTurk HIT instructions for Minecraft command annotation
use_after_constant_for_mturk_footer: use the AFTER constant to close the MTurk HIT page with tooltip styling and jQuery scripts
